body.input: Which software companies opened an office in Sweden in 2026?

response.content:
Based on available information, the following software/technology companies opened offices in Sweden in 2026:

1. **KPIT Technologies** — Opened a new technology centre in Gothenburg at Lindholmen Science Park, focusing on software-defined mobility for European automotive OEMs.

2. **Advantech** — The Taiwanese industrial technology and IoT company opened a Nordic office in Stockholm on September 10, 2026, to serve growing demand for edge computing and AI technologies across the Nordic region.

Note: **FPT** (a global technology corporation) opened its first office in Sweden in Gothenburg, though this was reported in September 2024 rather than 2026.

This list reflects publicly reported office openings and may not be exhaustive. Other companies may have established a presence in Sweden during 2026 without prominent public announcements.

explainability.content: The fact with ID d2d50a03-ee89-4b7e-a846-bde6b702756d states that KPIT Technologies opened a new technology centre in Gothenburg, Sweden, indicating an office opening in 2026.
The fact with ID b1fb18b4-b28b-440a-bca0-510b56fd0eb4 reports that Advantech opened a Nordic office in Stockholm on September 10, 2026, confirming its office establishment in Sweden that year.
Since both KPIT Technologies and Advantech are software/technology companies and each fact confirms an office opening in Sweden in 2026, they are the companies listed in the answer.

# Taiwanese tech company Advantech opens Nordic office in Sweden

-  by Mille Tanya Andersen - Leave a Comment

ShareSharePin ItShare

Photo: Facebook [...] Photo: Facebook

Taiwanese industrial technology company Advantech has opened a new Nordic office in Stockholm, strengthening its presence in the Nordic market as demand for edge computing and artificial intelligence technologies grows.

The office was officially opened on September 10, with Advantech President Miller Chang joined by Taiwan’s representative to Sweden, Ambassador Phoebe Yeh, and Anders Ahnlid, Director-General of the Swedish National Board of Trade. [...] Advantech, a global provider of industrial computing and IoT solutions, said the new office will help strengthen partnerships with customers and businesses across the Nordic region. Around 60 customers and partners attended the opening and a subsequent Solution Day, according to Advantech Europe.

The company’s business in Sweden has grown significantly in recent years, with sales increasing from around US$10 million to US$45 million, according to the Taiwanese mission in Sweden.
